item.title: ‘Still a lockdown’: Deadly floods hit Nepal tourism as peak season begins
item.description: As Himalayan nation recovers from devastating floods, a million people dependent on tourism struggle to make ends meet.

item.title: Russian strikes kill eight, injure dozens across Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian leader Zelenskyy says Moscow launched nearly 4,000 drones, aerial bombs and missiles on Ukraine in past week.

item.title: Sudanese army impounds dozens of motorcycles in Blue Nile curfew
item.description: Dozens of motorcycles were impounded in Sudan’s Blue Nile State, after their riders were accused of flouting a curfew.

item.title: Serbia’s president resigns to run for prime minister
item.description: Serbia’s Aleksandar Vucic has resigned as president and will lead his ruling party into a snap parliamentary election.

item.title: 14 killed, a dozen missing as Nepal is hit by more floods and landslides
item.description: At least 14 people have been killed and 11 remain missing after heavy rain triggered floods and landslides across Nepal.

item.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei to have dinner with Trump at White House
item.description: Private dinner will be the first one-on-one meeting between the two men, according to reports.

item.title: Venezuelans rally for opposition leader’s return and presidential elections
item.description: Nobel laureate Maria Corina Machado has been living in exile, with plans to return to Venezuela spoiled multiple times.

item.title: Palestine Action protesters arrested outside UK Labour Party conference
item.description: Demonstrators protest against UK government's proscription of Palestine Action as a 'terrorist' organisation.

item.title: Ireland beats Israel 3-0 wearing black armbands to support Gaza
item.description: Ireland scored a 3-0 victory over Israel in a politically-charged UEFA Nations League match played in Hungary.

item.title: UK Foreign Secretary confronted by activists over Palestine Action ban
item.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband was confronted by activists at a restaurant over the proscription of Palestine Action.

item.title: Ben-Gvir releases video threatening to kill senior Hamas figure in jail
item.description: Israel’s security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has released a video in which he is seen threatening to kill Hassan Salameh.

item.title: Refugees in South Africa fear new attacks as September 30 deadline looms
item.description: Refugees in Durban say they have nowhere safe to return to after being forced from a makeshift camp.

item.title: South African police discover body of 11th woman near Johannesburg
item.description: Police are investigating the killings in a country with one of the highest femicide rates in the world.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran open to ‘real diplomacy’, ready for ‘apocalyptic war’
item.description: Abbas Araghchi's warning comes after Washington rejected a seven-day roadmap to end the war and reopen Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Pope pledges action on clergy child abuse in meeting with French survivors
item.description: Head of the Roman Catholic Church holds 'emotional' two-hour meeting with seven survivors in French town of Lourdes.

item.title: Man City’s 115 Charges — The Scandal, The Escape, and Pep’s Own Past
item.description: Man City just got found guilty on 114 of 115 financial charges — but the story behind it is much more complex.

item.title: Powerful storm floods US Northeast, causes power outages
item.description: The nor'easter causes another round of flooding in low-lying areas in New Jersey and New York City and knocks out power.

item.title: Ireland defeats Israel in controversial UEFA Nations League match
item.description: Ireland's players wore black armbands in support of Palestine, bowed their heads, and refused pre-match handshakes.

item.title: Alleged rape on campus sparks violent protest at Indian university
item.description: Student protests at an Indian university have turned violent following claims that a female student was raped on campus.

item.title: Floods inundate roads in southeastern Algeria
item.description: Circulating footage showed significant flooding, following heavy rain in southeastern Algeria.

item.title: Ramos fires holders Portugal to 2-1 Nations League win in Norway
item.description: Goncalo Ramos starts in place of Cristiano Ronaldo and scores the winner for Portugal in Oslo.

item.title: Deadly strike hits market in Yemen’s Taiz
item.description: A strike on a market in the Yemeni city of Taiz has killed at least seven people and wounded 40.

item.title: Israeli strikes continue in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
item.description: An Israeli Apache helicopter struck a commercial centre near Mayfadoun in Southern Lebanon.

item.title: Five arrested near UK RAF base over suspected explosives ‘terror’ plot
item.description: Five men have been arrested near RAF Fairford in the UK on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences.

item.title: Ethiopian army reportedly recaptures strategic town as fighting spreads
item.description: Ethiopia’s army has reportedly recaptured the strategic town of Sekota from Tigrayan forces as fighting spreads.
